events.title: Stripe

agenda.speaker: Greg Buehrer, Chrissie Cui, Shep Walker, Soam Vasani, Yiing Chau Mak

people.name: John Collison
people.bio: Stripe联合创始人兼总裁。2009年与兄长Patrick Collison共同创立Stripe（前身为DevPayments），将其发展为全球最大的在线支付基础设施平台之一，服务数百万企业，2025年处理超1.4万亿美元交易。曾就读于哈佛大学，后辍学全身心投入Stripe。主导Stripe在AI、全球市场拓展和金融基础设施领域的战略布局。2026年入选《时代》杂志全球最具影响力100人。曾入选《福布斯》30 Under 30，是硅谷最年轻的亿万富翁之一。

people.name: Ryan Drapeau
people.bio:
Ryan leads the machine learning systems behind Stripe’s payment intelligence, including the fraud detection and authorization optimization models that train continuously on Stripe’s network-wide transaction data. He is the technical architect behind Stripe Radar and Adaptive Acceptance, and holds multiple U.S. patents. He studied Machine Learning at the University of Washington and has spent over seven years at Stripe.

Ryan负责Stripe支付智能背后的机器学习系统，包括基于全网交易数据持续训练的欺诈检测和授权优化模型。他是Stripe Radar和Adaptive Acceptance的技术架构师，持有多项美国专利。他在华盛顿大学学习机器学习，在Stripe工作超过七年。

people.name: Stathis Vafeias
people.bio:
Stathis holds a PhD in Artificial Intelligence from the University of Edinburgh. His research has been published at NeurIPS and IEEE ICRA. Before Stripe, he served as Head of Machine Learning at AimBrain, a biometric authentication company. At Stripe, he advances the deep learning and foundation model architectures that underpin fraud scoring, authorization optimization, and routing intelligence.

Stathis拥有爱丁堡大学人工智能博士学位，研究成果发表于NeurIPS和IEEE ICRA。加入Stripe前，他担任生物识别认证公司AimBrain的机器学习负责人。在Stripe，他推进深度学习和基础模型架构，支撑全网络的欺诈评分、授权优化和路由智能。

people.name: Michelle Bu
people.role: Head of Product Platforms & Developer Experience
people.bio:
Michelle joined Stripe in 2013 and is one of the company’s most senior engineering leaders. She was the lead architect of the Payment Intents API, the multi-year redesign of Stripe’s core payment flow. She authored the widely-read engineering retrospective “Stripe’s Payments APIs: The First 10 Years” and has delivered the developer keynote at Stripe Sessions. She oversees Stripe’s product platforms, API design, and developer experience. She studied at UC Berkeley.

Michelle于2013年加入Stripe，是公司最资深的工程领导者之一。她是Payment Intents API的首席架构师，主导了Stripe核心支付流程的多年重构。她撰写了广受关注的工程回顾文章《Stripe’s Payments APIs: The First 10 Years》，并在Stripe Sessions上发表过开发者主题演讲。她负责Stripe的产品平台、API设计和开发者体验。毕业于UC Berkeley。

people.name: Jason Gupta
people.bio:
Jason leads the product for Stripe Connect, the infrastructure that enables marketplaces and platforms to onboard merchants, route payouts, split fees, and manage multi-market compliance through a single integration. He has driven Connect’s expansion into a full-stack marketplace operating layer. Before Stripe, he spent several years at Google, building products including Android Messages and Google Photos. He studied at Georgia Tech.

Jason负责Stripe Connect的产品，这是使市场和平台能够通过单一集成完成商户入驻、付款路由、费用拆分和多市场合规的基础设施。他推动Connect扩展为全栈市场运营层。加入Stripe前，他在Google工作多年，参与构建Android Messages和Google Photos等产品。毕业于Georgia Tech。

people.name: Andrew Garvin
people.role: Head of Technical Architecture, Billing & Monetization
people.bio:
Andrew is a co-founder and former COO of Metronome, the usage-based billing platform acquired by Stripe in January 2026. At Metronome, he built the operational foundations for a product that became the billing infrastructure for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Databricks. His first role out of college was at Clarium Capital, Peter Thiel’s global macro hedge fund. At Stripe, he leads technical architecture for billing and monetization, working with AI-native companies on metered consumption, token-based pricing, and cross-border invoicing.

Andrew是Metronome的联合创始人兼前COO，该按用量计费平台于2026年1月被Stripe收购。在Metronome，他为OpenAI、Anthropic和Databricks的计费基础设施搭建了运营基础。他大学毕业后的第一份工作是在Peter Thiel的全球宏观对冲基金Clarium Capital。在Stripe，他负责计费和变现的技术架构，与AI原生公司合作解决计量消费、基于token的定价和大规模跨境开票等挑战。

people.name: Kevin Cullen
people.bio:
Kevin leads Stripe’s commercial relationships with leading AI companies across the Americas. With over five years at Stripe in strategic go-to-market roles, his work sits at the center of how Stripe’s billing and payments infrastructure evolves alongside the AI economy.

Kevin负责Stripe与美洲领AI公司的商业合作关系。他在Stripe战略市场推广岗位工作超过五年，处于Stripe计费与支付基础设施如何随AI经济发展的核心位置。

people.name: Greg Buehrer
people.role: Head of AI & Machine Learning Foundations
people.bio:
Before joining Stripe, Greg served as Corporate Vice President and CTO of Azure Machine Learning at Microsoft. He has published extensively in KDD, PPoPP, ICDM, IPDPS, and WWW. At Stripe, Greg leads the AI/ML Foundations team, responsible for the core AI and machine learning infrastructure that powers both Stripe’s customer-facing products and its internal AI agent systems.

加入Stripe前，Greg担任微软Azure机器学习的公司副总裁兼CTO。他在KDD、PPoPP、ICDM等顶级会议上发表了大量论文。在Stripe，Greg领导AI/ML基础团队，负责支撑Stripe面向客户的产品和内部AI Agent系统的核心AI与机器学习基础设施。

people.name: Chrissie Cui
people.bio:
Chrissie leads Stripe’s company-wide AI agent platform, extending AI-assisted workflows beyond engineering into sales, operations, and business functions. Previously, she held senior engineering leadership roles at Google and Bloomberg. Her teams delivered a 26% reduction in compliance review handling time through production AI agents. She co-authored “Production-Grade AI Agents for Financial Compliance: Lessons from Stripe” and presented at AWS re:Invent 2025.

Chrissie领导Stripe全公司范围的AI Agent平台，将AI辅助工作流从工程扩展到销售、运营和业务职能。此前，她在Google和Bloomberg担任高级工程领导职务。她的团队通过生产级AI Agent将合规审查处理时间缩短26%。她合著了《Production-Grade AI Agents for Financial Compliance: Lessons from Stripe》，并在AWS re:Invent 2025上发表演讲。

people.name: Shep Walker
people.bio:
Shep leads AI-powered developer tooling at Stripe, overseeing how AI augments the daily workflows of Stripe’s engineering organization. Previously at Microsoft, he holds U.S. patents in CI/CD automation. His teams built and rolled out Minions, Stripe’s autonomous coding agents, across the engineering workforce. He studied at the College of William & Mary.

Shep领导Stripe的AI驱动开发者工具，负责AI如何增徺Stripe工程团队的日常工作流。此前在微软任职，持有CI/CD自动化的美国专利。他的团队构建并推广了Stripe的自主编码Agent——Minions，覆盖整个工程团队。毕业于College of William & Mary。

people.name: Soam Vasani
people.bio:
Soam is the builder behind Minions, Stripe’s AI coding agent demonstrated live in this session. Before Minions, he created Fission, a widely-adopted open-source serverless framework for Kubernetes, leading to speaking at QCon London and Google Cloud Platform Podcast. At Stripe, he designed and built Minions from the ground up.

Soam是Minions的构建者——Stripe的AI编码Agent，将在本次会议中现场演示。在构建Minions之前，他创建了Fission，一个被广泛采用的Kubernetes开源无服务器框架，并因此在QCon London等场合发表演讲。在Stripe，他从零设计并构建了Minions。

people.name: Yiing Chau Mak
people.bio:
Mak leads the team responsible for evaluating and governing the quality of AI agent outputs across Stripe. He holds a BA from Stanford University and an MSc from the London School of Economics. Before Stripe, he served as Head of AI & Data at Ario and Senior Director of Data at MetaMap. His earlier career includes cybersecurity work at Singapore’s Cyber Security Agency. He publishes a widely-read technical series on design patterns for AI agents. Mak also provides Mandarin-language support during this session.

Mak领导负责评估和治理Stripe全公司AI Agent输出质量的团队。他拥有斯坦福大学学士学位和伦敦政治经济学院硕士学位。加入Stripe前，他担任Ario的AI与数据负责人和MetaMap的数据高级总监。早期职业生涯包括在新加坡网络安全局从事网络安全工作。他发表了广受关注的AI Agent设计模式技术系列文章。Mak在本次Session中同时提供中文支持。

people.name: Ernie Tedeschi
people.bio:
Before joining Stripe, Ernie served as Chief Economist at the White House Council of Economic Advisers. Prior to the White House, he was Managing Director and Head of Fiscal Analysis at Evercore ISI. He remains a Nonresident Senior Fellow at Yale’s Budget Lab and a Visiting Fellow at Georgetown’s Psaros Center. He holds degrees from Stanford University and UC Berkeley. At Stripe, he leads research on cross-border trade, AI’s economic impact, and regulatory trends. His work has been cited in the Wall Street Journal, New York Times, and The Atlantic.

加入Stripe前，Ernie担任白宫经济顾问委员会首席经济学家。此前，他是Evercore ISI的董事总经理兼财政分析主管。他目前仍是耶鲁大学预算实验室的非常驻高级研究员和乔治城大学Psaros中心的访问学者。他拥有斯坦福大学和UC Berkeley的学位。在Stripe，他领导关于跨境贸易、AI经济影响和监管趋势的研究。他的工作被《华尔街日报》、《纽约时报》和《大西洋月刊》引用。

📋 Documents Checklist (print all digital docs)

☐ Valid passport + US visa (if visa is in old passport, bring it along)

☐ Team rented two 7-seat MPVs — bring driver's license + translation (if available)

☐ Flight itinerary + hotel confirmation

☐ Simple itinerary (for customs)

☐ Legal letter (extreme backup only)

🧳 Packing Reminders

☐ US power adapter + power bank (3C certified, ≤100Wh)

☐ Bring spare laptop from China / pick up from US office IT

☐ Some hotels don't provide disposables — bring toothbrush, slippers, etc.

☐ Employee badge (Sunnyvale office access)

☐ Personal medications (prescriptions need original packaging + records)

📌 Important Notices

1. EVUS Update

If you hold a 10-year US visa, ensure EVUS is updated. Official site: https://www.evus.gov/

2. Time Zone

SF Bay Area is in Pacific Time, 15 hours behind Beijing.

e.g. Beijing 10am Sep 14 → SF 7pm Sep 13

3. Currency & Spending

Bring $100–200 in cash; most places accept cards. Tips are typically 18%–20%.

4. International Roaming

Activate international roaming before departure via your carrier's app. Purchase a US data plan.

5. Weather & Clothing 🌤️

Sep SF Bay Area: ☀️ Partly cloudy, approx 14°C ~ 28°C.

Large day/night temperature swings; bring a light windbreaker. Strong UV — use sunscreen.

6. Safety Tips

• Bring your work laptop (available from IT in Hangzhou or Sunnyvale)

• Keep your phone charged and reachable, especially around customs. Consider uninstalling DingTalk before entry and reinstalling after.

• Safety details: US Travel Safety Plan (includes customs Q&A)
